headings.usage: Mission titles, section headers, Escape room card titles. MUST BE SERIF UPPERCASE.

body.usage: Historical texts, briefing paragraphs, and dossier content.

ui.usage: Timer, AI outputs, scores, buttons, HUD elements, and semantic code-like feedback.

textures: Use subtle SVG noise overlays or apply the provided paper texture image with mix-blend-multiply and low opacity (10-20%) over the cream background.
shadows: Inner shadows for 'stamp' effects or pressed states to simulate vintage embossing.
borders: Dashed borders for drag-and-drop zones in Mission 3.
shapes: Rounded corners for cards, buttons, and panels.

layouts.app_structure: Left/Center main content area + Right sidebar for Actions/Leaderboards. Footer fixed at bottom with text 'Made with ♥ by Nuova-Mente'.
layouts.teacher_dashboard: Bento grid matrix (Mode B) for students x missions. High density, semantic color indicators.
layouts.mission_view: Focused center card for active mission with right sliding drawer (Sheet) for Dossier sources.
layouts.cards: Rounded corners with an overlay label anchored at the bottom edge.

components.timer: Visible, non-blocking timer in HUD. Font: IBM Plex Mono. Subtle pulse animation on low time.
components.dossier_drawer: Use Shadcn 'Sheet' component sliding from the right. Background must be opaque cream, no transparency.
components.drag_drop: Two-column grid for 'cause remote vs immediate'. Muted background drop zones with dashed borders.
components.buttons: Rounded/pill-shaped. Primary: bg-[#D4A72C] text-[#2B2620]. Secondary: transparent with gold outline.
components.file_extension: USE .js and .jsx FILES EXCLUSIVELY. Do NOT create .tsx files.

motion.transitions: Smooth translations for drawer slide. Avoid transition:all.
motion.feedback: Semantic color flashes on correct/incorrect actions. Typewriter reveal effect for new briefings.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text against #FDF3D0 and #D4A72C meets WCAG AA. Use #2B2620 for text to guarantee high contrast.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the design system: base `#FDF3D0`, gold `#D4A72C`, serif uppercase headings, rounded cards with bottom overlay labels.
Implement the layout with a right sidebar for Actions/Leaderboards and the footer 'Made with ♥ by Nuova-Mente'.
Use .js/.jsx for all files since this is a React+JS environment.
Build the 5 specific missions. Differentiate the 'historical' texts (serif) from the 'AI outputs' (mono font, slightly glitchy or highlightable).
Ensure the Timer is non-blocking and always visible in the HUD along with the score.
Use Shadcn UI properly, overriding styles with Tailwind to match the vintage dossier vibe.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for the drawer, dialogs, or dropdowns. Make them solid cream or blur with high opacity.
Teacher Dashboard: create a highly readable, dense grid (students rows, mission columns) with desaturated semantic colors for status.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive and key informational elements.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) ONLY if it does not compromise readability.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements only.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Align text naturally for readability.
Always use modern button styles with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭) for icons. Use lucide-react icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations.
Use generous spacing. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
